say:1:1710772001:1.text: Well, well. Quite the spectacle of the "destined hero". Director, actors, props, even the narration.
say:1:1710772001:1.source_cn: 啧啧啧……好一出天命所归的大戏啊……导演、演员、道具，...

say:2:1710772002:1.text: And they threw in the Mirror Wraith too...
say:2:1710772002:1.source_cn: 甚至还出现了魔灵镜影这个新演员呢……

choice_prompt:3:1710772002.text: And they threw in the Mirror Wraith too...
choice_prompt:3:1710772002.source_cn: 甚至还出现了魔灵镜影这个新演员呢……

say:4:1710772003:1.text: Obviously. If a real Hypofiend had dropped in, those nobles would be decorative smears by now.
say:4:1710772003:1.source_cn: 当然是假的。真正的深渊魔物要是真身降临，这群贵族早就没命啦！

say:5:1710772004:1.text: But for scaring those aristocrats? Perfect.
say:5:1710772004:1.source_cn: 不过用来吓唬这群没见过世面的家伙，倒是足够了。
say:5:1710772004:1.male: But for scaring those aristocrats? Perfect.
say:5:1710772004:1.female: But for scaring those aristocrats? Perfect.

say:6:1710772005:1.text: You didn't expect them to pivot so fast. After the hunting grounds incident, they turned their new plan into a staged "miracle".
say:6:1710772005:1.source_cn: 你们没有想到，他们在猎场受挫之后，竟能如此迅速地修改计...
say:6:1710772005:1.male: You didn't expect them to pivot so fast. After the hunting grounds incident, they turned their new plan into a staged "miracle".
say:6:1710772005:1.female: You didn't expect them to pivot so fast. After the hunting grounds incident, they turned their new plan into a staged "miracle".

say:7:1710772006:1.text: From the banquet, to the Hall of Ancients' reappearance, to the Hypofiend and Cyran's stirring explanation. Everything was meticulously crafted.
say:7:1710772006:1.source_cn: 从晚宴的邀约、圣古堂的重现，到魔物的登场，再到迪尔格雷...

say:8:1710772007:1.text: Cyran set the mood perfectly. By morning, all of Savannah will be buzzing about tonight.
say:8:1710772007:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷已经把气氛烘托到位了。搞不好不用等到明天天亮，...
